mapper.select: select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.name as name, s.major_id as majorId, s.entry_year as entryYear, s.college as college, s.cum_gpa as cumGpa, s.total_credits as totalCredits, coalesce(nullif(m.major_name_zh, ''), m.major_name_en, m.major_code, '') as majorName, m.major_code as majorCode from edu_student s left join edu_major m on m.major_id = s.major_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.student_id = #{studentId}
select term_id as termId, term_code as termCode, term_name as termName, academic_year as academicYear, term_index as termIndex, is_current as isCurrent from edu_term order by term_code asc

select r.category as category, sum(coalesce(nullif(r.units, 0), c.credits, 0)) as credits, count(1) as courseCount from edu_course_record r left join edu_course c on c.course_id = r.course_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' and r.del_flag = '0' group by r.category order by credits desc
